title: Change File Permissions
description: Apply a safe configurable permission mode to a file.
script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

FILE="${1:-}"
MODE="${2:-640}"

if [[ -z "$FILE" || ! -f "$FILE" ]]; then
    echo "Usage: $0 /path/to/file 640" >&2
    exit 1
fi

chmod "$MODE" "$FILE"

echo "Updated permissions:"
stat -c '%n %A (%a)' "$FILE"
